name: balkanid
description: Identity security and governance for humans, non-humans and AI agents.

interface.longDescription:
BalkanID is an identity governance and administration (IGA) platform for humans, non-humans and AI agents. This connector brings your BalkanID tenant into the conversation, so you can see who has access to what, request access and run user access reviews without leaving the conversation.

With this connector you can:
- Discover identities, connections, resources, credentials and entity relations across your integrated applications
- Create access requests for employees and agents, and request just-in-time access through JITPBAC Purposes
- Approve, reject or delegate access requests and campaign reviews assigned to you
- List access review campaigns and track pending reviews
- Keep employee records up to date
- Trigger an integration sync and search the BalkanID documentation

Every action runs as the signed-in user with their BalkanID roles. Reviewers only see reviews assigned to them, and create or change actions need the Write scope granted at sign-in.
defaultPrompt: Show the access reviews waiting on me
Which credentials have expired, and who owns them?
Show access requests waiting for my approval

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Run user access reviews, request and approve access (including just-in-time access through Purposes), discover identities, connections, resources and credentials, and search the BalkanID documentation.

positive.prompt: Who am I signed in as in BalkanID, and what am I allowed to do?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the signed-in user's email, tenant, BalkanID roles and granted scopes.

positive.description: List access reviews assigned to the user
positive.prompt: Show the access reviews waiting on me.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pending campaign review items assigned to the signed-in user, with the identity and access under review for each.

positive.prompt: Approve the first access review waiting on me with the reason "Still needed for current project".
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, approves one pending review with the given reason and confirms it is no longer pending.

positive.prompt: Which API keys have expired, and who owns them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists expired credentials with their app, name, expiry date and owner, or says the owner is unknown.

positive.description: Request just-in-time access through a purpose
positive.prompt: Show the purposes I can request, then request the first one I'm not assigned to.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists purposes with the user's eligibility, asks for confirmation, creates a purpose request and returns its request ID and pending status.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Bangalore today?
Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.
Book a meeting room for 3pm tomorrow.
